description: Ministry of Sports - The Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) w.e.f. 01.01.2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No. 33 of 2013. It publishes the official prohibited list of substances and methods in sports, which constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements under statutory instruments. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it establishes binding rules and standards rather than dealing with government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
